text.en:
Section 2 of EO 770 is hereby amended to read as follows:
"SECTION 2. Composition. The NB-NLUC shall be composed of
the following:
Chairperson: Secretary of Socio-Economic Planning
: Secretaries of Environment and Natural
Resources; Agriculture; Agrarian Reform;
Trade and Industry: Public Works and
Transportation
Communications; Tourism; Interior and Local
Government; Justice; Science and Technology;
Chairpersons of the Housing and Urban
Development Coordinating Council/Housing and
Land Use Regulatory Board; and the National
POMA Hologram # 50812

Commission on Indigenous People.
Presidents of the League of Provinces,
Municipalities and Cities.
Two private sector representatives."

All executive orders and executive issuances or portions
thereof which are inconsistent with this Executive Order are hereby revoked,
amended or modified accordingly.

This Executive Order shall take effect immediately.
DONE in the City of Manila, this 30th day of September, in the year of
Our Lord, Two Thousand Nine.
Flare a hung
By the President:
EDUARDO R. ERMITA
Executive Secretary
